---
title: "Baseline Lab Characteristics Histograms"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.show = "show")
```

```{r config-and-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)

# Load config and functions
source(here("config.R"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "histogram_cont_var_func.r"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "barchart_cat_var_func.r"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "barchart_multi_indicator_func.r"))

# Output directory
hist_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT, "6_Histograms")
dir.create(hist_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(file.path(CLEAN_DATA, "final_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r create-vars}
# Sharing equipment and space indicators
for (var in c("share_equip", "share_space")) {
  df[[var]] <- ifelse(df[[paste0(var, "_ind")]] == "Yes", 1, 0)
}

# Specialized equipment indicators (fix 4c room column name)
spec_equip_source_cols <- c(
  pcr              = "pcr_ind",
  ice              = "ice_ind",
  centrifuge       = "centrifuge_ind",
  coffee           = "coffee_ind",
  microwave        = "microwave_ind",
  animal           = "animal_ind",
  nonco2_incubator = "nonco2_incubator_ind",
  c4_room          = "X4c_room_ind",
  minus_20c_room   = "minus_20c_room_ind",
  other            = "other_ind"
)
for (var in names(spec_equip_source_cols)) {
  df[[paste0(var, "_indicator")]] <- 
  ifelse(df[[spec_equip_source_cols[[var]]]] == "Yes", 1, 0)
}

# Any specialized equipment indicator
indicator_cols <- paste0(names(spec_equip_source_cols), "_indicator")
df$any_spec_indicator <- 
  as.integer(rowSums(df[indicator_cols] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
```

```{r restrict-sample}
# Keep only labgroupids with both BL and EL data, then keep the BL row
df_sample <- df %>%
  group_by(labgroupid) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

df_bl <- df_sample %>% 
  filter(survey == "BL")
```

# Number of Researchers

```{r no-researchers-overall}
make_histogram(
  df          = df_bl,
  variable    = "no_researchers",
  output_file = "hist_no_researchers_overall.pdf",
  binwidth    = 2,
  boundary    = 0,
  show_median = TRUE,
  output_dir  = hist_dir
)
```

```{r no-researchers-by-treatment}
make_histogram(
  df           = df_bl,
  variable     = "no_researchers",
  group_var    = "treated",
  group_labels = list("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment"),
  output_file  = "hist_no_researchers_by_treatment.pdf",
  binwidth     = 2,
  boundary     = 0,
  show_median  = TRUE,
  output_dir   = hist_dir
)
```

# Number of Full-Time Researchers

```{r no-ft-overall}
make_histogram(
```


# Faculty

```{r faculty-category-order, include=FALSE}
faculty_order  <- c(
  "Faculty of Science (MNF)", "Faculty of Medicine (MeF)", "Both MNF and MeF"
)
faculty_labels <- list(
  "Faculty of Science (MNF)"  = "Science",
  "Faculty of Medicine (MeF)" = "Medicine",
  "Both MNF and MeF"          = "Joint"
)
```

```{r faculty-overall}
make_barchart(
  df              = df_bl,
  variable        = "faculty",
  category_order  = faculty_order,
  category_labels = faculty_labels,
  output_file     = "bar_faculty_overall.pdf",
  output_dir      = hist_dir
)
```

```{r faculty-by-treatment}
make_barchart(
  df              = df_bl,
  variable        = "faculty",
  group_var       = "treated",
  group_labels    = list("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment"),
  category_order  = faculty_order,
  category_labels = faculty_labels,
  output_file     = "bar_faculty_by_treatment.pdf",
  output_dir      = hist_dir
)
```

# Specialized Equipment

```{r spec-equip-labels, include=FALSE}
# All specialized equipment plus "any" in one chart
spec_equip_labels <- c(
  pcr_indicator              = "PCR Machine",
  ice_indicator              = "Ice Machine",
  centrifuge_indicator       = "Centrifuge",
  coffee_indicator           = "Coffee Machine",
  microwave_indicator        = "Microwave",
  animal_indicator           = "Animal Facility",
  nonco2_incubator_indicator = "Non-CO2 Incubator",
  c4_room_indicator          = "4°C Room",
  minus_20c_room_indicator   = "-20°C Room",
  other_indicator            = "Other",
  any_spec_indicator         = "Any"
)
```

```{r spec-equip-overall}
make_indicator_barchart(
  df          = df_bl,
  item_cols   = names(spec_equip_labels),
  item_labels = spec_equip_labels,
  output_file = "bar_spec_equip_overall.pdf",
  output_dir  = hist_dir
)
```

```{r spec-equip-by-treatment}
make_indicator_barchart(
  df           = df_bl,
  item_cols    = names(spec_equip_labels),
  item_labels  = spec_equip_labels,
  group_var    = "treated",
  group_labels = list("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment"),
  output_file  = "bar_spec_equip_by_treatment.pdf",

)
```
